profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Information Technology Masters Graduate
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
“Trust in yourself, believe that your voice matters, and know that your words are good enough.”
— Amber Gordon, Founder of Femsplain

These are words of empowerment for a wide set of circumstances. 
Hi, there! I'm Karla, and these words empower me as a Latina woman in the technology industry.

Currently I am a Senior Software Engineer at Coforma, working with a team of engineers, designers, and product owners to build and maintain a government healthcare web application. In my role, I am constantly communicating with clients and stakeholders, leading technical conversations with fellow engineers, and writing code to meet the needs of our users across the website. Additionally, I have interviewed candidates for the engineering team, and mentored junior developers by providing support with their career and technical growth.

In my previous role of Software Engineer with Verizon Communications, I worked with end-users to automate the process of onboarding into the AWS Public Cloud. My team followed Agile methodologies to improve our customers' experience in the Public Cloud and to deliver scalable solutions adapted to their specific needs.

Prior to graduating in June of 2018, I studied Computer Engineering with a focus on Software in the University of Puerto Rico at Mayagüez. Throughout these years as a Bachelors student, I developed my coding, problem solving, and team collaboration skills. However, even after graduating from my Bachelors, I felt a strong desire to expand my knowledge further, thus I decided to pursue a Masters of Information Technology with Virginia Tech, starting in January of 2019 and graduating January of 2023.  

Outside of my day-to-day work and studies, I am a strong advocate for diversity, equity, and inclusion in the fields of STEM, academic and professional. As part of that effort, I represented Verizon Communications in my Alma Mater, the University of Puerto Rico at Mayagüez, as a recruiter in their annual Fall Job Fair. At this event, our team recruited over thirty Latinx candidates for internships and full-time opportunities with the company.

Whenever I have some free time, I love to go bouldering, hiking, and I am always signing up for the latest 5Ks. But don't let all of these physical activities fool you, I am a "foodie" at heart (especially for dessert) with a passion for watching movies and lounging with my Nintendo Switch at hand.

Anyway, please feel free to reach out if you'd like to chat!

projects.title: eCSP
projects.description:
Capstone Course Project

eCSP is a website for Dr. Ismael Segarra to securely and efficiently share medical documents with patients. Patients can access their medical records at all times from a mobile device, a tablet, or a personal computer. The doctor and his clinic administrators can access patient records and manage them. 

The webpage frontend was developed using AngularJS with HTML + CSS. The backend of the webpage was developed using Python + Flask. The database is PostgreSQL and the storage is Amazon S3 Cloud Storage Service.
